title: Paper Pilot: A Human-in-the-Loop Expert System for Evidence-Traceable Scientific Manuscript Generation in Applied Sciences
abstract: arXiv:2608.28596v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly embedded in scientific workflows for literature analysis, drafting, and review. Existing systems advance autonomous discovery and manuscript generation, but do not resolve the governance problem that arises when ideas, methods, results, and claims propagate through AI-assisted workflows without mandatory human approval or artifact-level traceability. This paper proposes Paper Pilot, a human-in-the-loop expert system for evidence-traceable scientific manuscript generation in applied sciences. It adapts the Collaborative Agent Reasoning Engineering (CARE) methodology to manuscript development through manuscript-owner approval gates, explicit no-pass criteria, claim classification, audit logging, advisory LLM review, and evidence-locked revision control. The framework defines eight approval gates across the idea-to-claim pipeline and distinguishes literature-grounded from artifact-grounded

translated_title: Paper Pilot：一种面向应用科学、具有证据可追溯性的科学手稿生成的人在回路专家系统
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体正日益被嵌入到科学工作流程中，用于文献分析、起草和审阅。现有系统推动了自主发现和手稿生成的进展，但未能解决一个治理问题：当思想、方法、结果和论断在AI辅助的工作流程中传播时，缺乏强制性的人类批准或工件级（artifact-level）的可追溯性。本文提出了Paper Pilot，一个面向应用科学、具有证据可追溯性的科学手稿生成的人在回路专家系统。该系统将协作智能体推理工程（CARE）方法论适配到手稿开发过程中，通过手稿所有者审批关卡、明确的未通过标准、论断分类、审计日志、咨询式LLM审阅以及证据锁定的修订控制来实现。该框架在整个从想法到论断的流程中定义了八个审批关卡，并区分了基于文献的和基于工件的……
tldr: 提出了Paper Pilot，一个通过手稿所有者审批关卡、论断分类、审计日志和证据锁定修订控制等机制，实现人在回路、证据可追溯的应用科学手稿生成专家系统。
en_tdlr: Paper Pilot is a human-in-the-loop expert system that enables evidence-traceable scientific manuscript generation in applied sciences through eight approval gates, claim classification, audit logging, and evidence-locked revision control.
